preconditions.name: oracle_resource_channel_clears_floor
preconditions.description: Greedy nearest-resource ORACLE (no agent) clears the competence floor in this exact env, proving the floor is ACHIEVABLE by a resource-seeking policy. SAME statistic as the agent DV (env.step info transition_type=='resource'). Below-floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER an H1/H2 verdict.
preconditions.control: greedy nearest-resource oracle forager, same ENV_KWARGS/seed

preconditions.name: baseline_reproduces_incompetence
preconditions.description: B0 (724 A0 bias-head REINFORCE all-ON) must forage BELOW the floor on a majority of seeds -- i.e. the 724 incompetence must reproduce -- for the H1/H2 discrimination to be meaningful. If B0 already clears the floor the premise is not reproduced => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: B0 mean_resources/ep vs floor (majority of seeds)

preconditions.name: sufficient_p2_episodes_all_cells
preconditions.description: Every completed cell must log >= MIN_P2_EPISODES P2 eval episodes so mean_resources_per_episode is estimable. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: min completed P2 episodes across all cells

hypotheses.H1: The competence deficit is in REE's ACTION-GENERATION stack (bias-head-only REINFORCE over prediction-only representations). A real trainable action head over REE's representation recovers foraging.
hypotheses.H2: The observation / env interface is unlearnable by ANY policy at this scale; the oracle only wins on privileged nearest-resource access. The target is the observation encoding, not the policy.

interpretation_grid.H1_policy_head_recovers_competence: readiness holds AND B2 (vanilla A2C on raw obs) clears the floor AND B1 (A2C head over REE representation) clears the floor. Bias-head-only was the bottleneck; a real action head over REE's representation forages. HYPOTHESIS: route to /implement-substrate to build a proper action/policy-learning substrate under f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.
interpretation_grid.H1_deeper_ree_representation_obstructs: readiness holds AND B2 clears the floor AND B1 does NOT. A vanilla policy learns the raw observation but the SAME policy over REE's representation cannot -> the deficit is in REE's representation processing (drives / world-model / encoder), not just the head. HYPOTHESIS: narrow the build to the representation, do NOT build the action head alone.
interpretation_grid.H2_observation_interface_unlearnable: readiness holds AND B2 does NOT clear the floor. Even a vanilla policy on the identical observation cannot forage at this budget -> target the OBSERVATION ENCODING, not the policy; a policy-learning build would be wasted. HYPOTHESIS (prudent follow-up before a large obs rebuild: confirm with a stronger learner / longer budget -- sub-floor under vanilla A2C at 200 episodes is a strong hint, not a proof of unlearnability).
interpretation_grid.flag_implausible_leakage_check: readiness holds AND B1 clears the floor AND B2 does NOT. A REE-encoded head beating a vanilla policy on observation derived from the SAME env information is implausible -> check for leakage / privileged input before trusting either arm.
interpretation_grid.substrate_not_ready_requeue: the greedy oracle cannot clear the floor (env does not permit it), OR B0 already forages >= floor (724 premise not reproduced), OR a cell logged fewer than MIN_P2_EPISODES eval episodes. NOT a verdict -- re-examine env/floor/budget and re-queue. Draw NO conclusion about H1 vs H2.

evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-732 POLICY-LEARNING DISCRIMINATOR (experiment_purpose=diagnostic, claim_ids=[], non_contributory -- EXCLUDED from governance scoring; PROMOTES / DEMOTES NOTHING). Resolves the H1/H2 fork left open by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-724_2026-07-09 (competence_deficit_diffuse; deficit localized to bias-head-only REINFORCE over prediction-only representations). Three arms, IDENTICAL env/seeds/protocol/floor/oracle to 724: B0 = 724 A0 incompetence anchor (bias-head REINFORCE all-ON); B1 = REE prediction-trained representation + a FULL trainable A2C action head (H1); B2 = vanilla A2C on the identical raw observation vector, no REE machinery (H2). B1 and B2 share the same A2C learner + budget so the contrast isolates the representation front-end. Greedy nearest-resource oracle (positive control) validates the floor is achievable (oracle_min/ep=6.05, clears_floor=True). Load-bearing DV: P2 mean_resources_per_episode. Self-route (HYPOTHESIS, not a verdict): readiness_met=True; b1_clears=False, b2_clears=False -> label=H2_observation_interface_unlearnable. Feeds the WS-1 build-direction decision in ree_ai_design_critique_plan.md (H1 -> action/policy substrate; H2 -> observation encoding). Route to /failure-autopsy for adjudication before any governance action or build.

config_summary.design: H1/H2 policy-learning discriminator; 3 arms x seeds + greedy-oracle positive control; env/oracle/B0 reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-724

arms.B0_ree_biashead_reinforce_allon: H0 anchor = 724 A0: all-ON REE, P0 e2 warmup, P1 two-head REINFORCE (lateral-PFC bias + OFC devaluation), encoder frozen in P1
arms.B1_ree_repr_full_a2c_head: H1: REE all-ON encoder prediction-warmed in P0 then FROZEN; a full trainable trunk+A2C head (own optimizer) over z_self(+)z_world learns the action
arms.B2_vanilla_a2c_rawobs: H2: vanilla A2C, matched trunk+head, over the raw observation vector (body_state(+)world_state(+)harm_obs(+)harm_obs_a(+)harm_history); no REE machinery

config_summary.matched_learner: B1 and B2 share online advantage-actor-critic (A2C) with identical hyperparameters and a 200-episode budget; only the representation front-end differs (REE latent vs raw obs). B0 budget fixed by faithfulness to 724 A0.
config_summary.load_bearing_dv: P2 mean_resources_per_episode (env.step info transition_type=='resource'), majority of seeds vs 1.0 floor
